encode_bboxes_to_delta: encode source bounding boxes into delta coordinates (dx, dy, dw, dh) relative to ground truth boxes
decode_delta_to_bboxes: decode delta coordinates back to bounding boxes by applying predicted deltas to base boxes with optional clipping
compute_bbox2delta: compute regression deltas of proposal boxes with respect to ground truth boxes using configurable means and stds
apply_delta2bbox: apply encoded deltas to shift and scale ROI boxes and convert back to top-left bottom-right format
review_DeltaXYWHBBoxCoder_class: review the DeltaXYWHBBoxCoder class that encodes and decodes bounding box deltas following R-CNN practice
